title: Рекордер Событий (Текст с пропусками)
description: Интеграция 4 времен (Simple, Cont, Perfect, Past) в текст о технологиях.

rounds.text: Technology in Our Lives. Technology has changed a lot recently. People use smartphones every day, and many of them download useful apps for studying and communication. Last week, we visited a modern factory and saw how new machines worked. Yesterday, I downloaded a new app and have already shown it to my friends. When I came home, my brother was playing video games. He hadn’t done his homework yet, so our parents asked him to turn off the computer and study.
